title: Branding and Marketing training for champion end users
tagline: To support livelihood improvement by helping producers enhance the quality and appearance of their products, follow basic standards, and reach more people, so they can earn dignified and reliable incomes while meeting the needs of their…
description:
To support livelihood improvement by helping producers enhance the quality and appearance of their products, follow basic standards, and reach more people, so they can earn dignified and reliable incomes while meeting the needs of their customers. Furthermore, allowing end users to improve their income security, expand their customer base, and strengthen long-term sustainability with higher levels of customer trust and satisfaction. The program seeks to support forward linkage training their products. SELCO will partners in rural, underserved geographies facing challenges in forward linkages.

Who took part: Champion end users.

title: Jackfruit training
tagline: The 3 day Exposure cum Hands-on Training held in Pune, Maharashtra in partnership with Jackfruit King FPC, aims to build the capacities of 4 selected farmers from the Boko region of Assam by exposing them to successful jackfruit value…
description:
The 3 day Exposure cum Hands-on Training held in Pune, Maharashtra in partnership with Jackfruit King FPC, aims to build the capacities of 4 selected farmers from the Boko region of Assam by exposing them to successful jackfruit value addition enterprises, equipping them with practical skills in processing techniques such as chips, flour, and pulp production, and familiarizing them with improved harvesting, post-harvest handling, packaging, and market linkage strategies — ultimately catalyzing their transition from raw produce sellers to value-added product entrepreneurs and strengthening a localized jackfruit value chain ecosystem in the region

Who took part: Champion Farmers.

title: Bankers Orientation Workshop
tagline: To introduce AGB’s General Manager and branch leaders to financing solar-powered livelihood technology, show how SELCO and DIYA Foundation work with entrepreneurs, and agree on practical steps to begin lending.
description:
To introduce AGB’s General Manager and branch leaders to financing solar-powered livelihood technology, show how SELCO and DIYA Foundation work with entrepreneurs, and agree on practical steps to begin lending. The workshop also brought entrepreneurs and local solar companies into the room, so bankers could hear first-hand how these machines raise incomes and how loan products can fit small borrowers. In doing so, it aimed to build the awareness, trust and working relationships needed to reach up to 500 entrepreneurs across four districts under the MoU.

Who took part: AGB’s General Manager and branch heads, with SELCO, DIYA Foundation, entrepreneurs and local clean energy enterprises companies.

title: Catalyzing climate Action in Fisheries
tagline: To share learnings from aquaculture interventions such as biofloc systems, pond aeration, nurseries and hatcheries, fish drying, and shrimp and crab farming, and to highlight the experiences of champion farmers.
description:
To share learnings from aquaculture interventions such as biofloc systems, pond aeration, nurseries and hatcheries, fish drying, and shrimp and crab farming, and to highlight the experiences of champion farmers. It also aimed to identify emerging challenges and opportunities across the fisheries value chain and build partnerships among ecosystem stakeholders, so that common priorities could inform SELCO’s future programmes.

Who took part: Champion fish farmers, government representatives, technology providers, researchers, NGOs and CSOs from Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram and Karnataka, along with SELCO teams.

title: Climate Smart Bodoland Udalguri
tagline: Event was designed as a one-day knowledge-sharing and enterprise promotion platform to empower rural enterprises through sustainable livelihoods and climate-smart technologies.
description: Event was designed as a one-day knowledge-sharing and enterprise promotion platform to empower rural enterprises through sustainable livelihoods and climate-smart technologies. It aimed to showcase successful livelihood initiatives, demonstrate decentralized renewable energy (DRE) solutions, and promote peer-to-peer learning among rural producer collectives and champion entrepreneurs. Additionally, the event facilitated critical linkages with financial institutions, government departments, and Clean Energy Enterprises (CEEs) to address operational challenges and build an enterprise pipeline for future support.
